instructionsHtml:
You have reached the end of the Getting Started module.

What to do next

  1. Replace the placeholder panel — Follow the instructions in architecture.md to build your interactive component.

  2. Add a real engine — Implement LessonEngine<S> in src/curriculum/lesson-engine.ts. The StubEngine marks everything as completed immediately; a real engine grades based on learner input.

  3. Write your lessons — Add lesson files to src/curriculum/lessons/ and register them in src/curriculum/ordering.ts. Run pnpm add-module and pnpm add-lesson to generate stubs.

  4. Set your donation ID — Replace "TODO" in donation-config.json with your project's donation ID. The HeaderControls test will fail until you do.

Good luck!
